question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **opt**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given words.
 
 
• "**Choose**" means to decide which thing or person you want out of the ones that are available.
 
• "**Pick**" means to choose somebody/something from a group of people or things.
 
• "**Select**" means carefully chosen as the best of a group.
 
• "**Opt**" means to choose or decide to do or have something after thinking about it.
 
 
 
• Though all the meanings are nearly similar to each other, **"opt"** is used as best when we talk about career or study.
 
 
• **Example -** *After graduating she **opted **for a career in music. *
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is: **option 4.**

**Complete Paragraph:** *One day, my six-year-old sister (1) **asked **__us which career she should (2) **__opt __**for. My father suggested (3)______ she should become a doctor, (4)______ my mother said she could (5)______ a newspaper reporter. I (6) ______ she would make a (7)______ teacher. After a brief (8)______ my sister declared, “I will become (9)______ actress. Then I will get an (10)______ to play all these roles.”*
